placeholderImages.description: A close-up vertical photograph of a white notebook page. The page is bright and clean, taking up the lower two-thirds of the frame. It features three lines of left-aligned text with slight size progression: 'Create like an artist.' (light), 'Solve like an engineer.' (bold), and 'Act like an entrepreneur.' (italic, largest). The background is a shallow-depth-of-field blur showing a dark desk surface and the out-of-focus shape of a smartphone. The lighting is bright, minimal, and professional.
